needed.evidence: Informal footpath under 1m width, partly blocked by obstructions and trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, raised sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: Informal footpath under 1m width, also partly obstructed by parked cars and debris
needed.suggestion: Install bollards or low fencing to prevent vehicles from parking on or blocking the informal footpath.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections along the informal path
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the informal path to address the uneven and broken sections.

needed.evidence: No proper crossing facility visible despite crossing demand indicated by pedestrian presence
needed.suggestion: Introduce a marked zebra crossing with traffic signals and a refuge island for safe pedestrian crossing.

needed.evidence: Crossing is poorly marked with potentially obscured visibility for drivers
needed.suggestion: Paint the zebra crossing with high-visibility markings and install additional lighting to improve visibility at the crossing.

needed.evidence: No kerb ramps or dropped kerbs seen at the crossing location
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to ensure safe access for pedestrians, including those with mobility challenges.
